name: home_price_response
description: Heating setpoint for one home with a heat pump and floor heating that shifts heat out of peak-price hours while keeping the room inside its comfort band. The sequence keeps no state: each step, TSet depends only on the inputs at that step. Prices: pri00 is the price for the current hour and pri01..pri23 the next 23 hours. Let dayMax and dayMin be the largest and smallest of pri00..pri23, spread = dayMax - dayMin, and threshold = dayMin + peak_share * spread. There are peak hours only when spread is greater than min_spread. When there are, the current hour is a peak hour if pri00 >= threshold (at the threshold counts), and a peak hour is coming if the largest of pri01, pri02 and pri03 is >= threshold. Comfort: TLo00..TLo02 are the lower comfort limit now, in 1 h and in 2 h; THi00..THi03 the upper limit now and in 1, 2 and 3 h. floorSoon is the largest of TLo00..TLo02 and ceilingSoon the smallest of THi00..THi03. base = the larger of (TLo00 + margin) and away_setpoint. normal = the larger of base and (floorSoon + margin). If the current hour is a peak hour, TSet = the larger of (base - coast_drop) and (floorSoon + coast_margin). Otherwise, if a peak hour is coming and TZon is not above normal + warm_band (exactly at it is not above), TSet = preheat: the smaller of (normal + preheat_amount) and (ceilingSoon - ceiling_gap), but never below normal. Otherwise TSet = normal. Temperatures are in kelvin; prices are per kWh in any currency.

params.name: peak_share
params.meaning: Share of the way from the day's lowest to highest price at which an hour counts as peak

params.name: min_spread
params.meaning: A day whose prices differ by no more than this has no peak hours

params.name: margin
params.meaning: Normal setpoint above the comfort floor

params.name: away_setpoint
params.meaning: Lowest normal setpoint (20.5 degC), used when the floor is low because nobody is home

params.name: coast_drop
params.meaning: How far below base the setpoint drops during a peak hour

params.name: coast_margin
params.meaning: Coasting never goes below the coming floor plus this

params.name: preheat_amount
params.meaning: Added to normal before a peak hour

params.name: ceiling_gap
params.meaning: Preheat stays at least this far below the coming ceiling

params.name: warm_band
params.meaning: No preheat when the room is more than this above normal
